items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And now, he's drunk and playing with me.

ctx.x: He was a bull. Him and Ben Webster and Ben Carter wasn't nothing but football players. Them are the strongest saxophone players I know to sit up and manhandle the horn and wasn't on the field hitting somebody block and tackle. They were brutes, that's what they were. And now, he's drunk and playing with me.

And I told him. And he felt so bad. I said, I don't want you to feel bad. I've lived through it many a year now. But now I think I can tell you. You are responsible for me having that operation because you knocked the hell out of me, playing. That's the whole thing. But don't you know I held it all these years? I told him last week (inaudible). Wasn't that beautiful? What could he have done if I had told him? Nothing. He couldn't correct it. He couldn't do nothing that the doctor couldn't do. And the doctor was…
